name: managing-artifact-lineage

method.focus: preserve immutable provenance, dependency edges, supersession, verification, and downstream invalidation
steps: Assign stable project-scoped IDs and canonical content hashes.
Record producing skill, agent identity, consumed artifacts, decisions, evidence, and residual risks.
Append new versions; never mutate previously verified content in place.
When upstream content changes, compute descendants and mark only affected artifacts invalidated.
Require independent verification before changing state to verified.
verification: Does the same canonical content produce the same hash?
Can every output reconstruct its input lineage?
Are unaffected branches preserved during invalidation?
Can a worker verify its own artifact?

procedure: Read the current project state and active gate.
Resolve only the minimum missing state required for routing.
Assign stable project-scoped IDs and canonical content hashes.
Record producing skill, agent identity, consumed artifacts, decisions, evidence, and residual risks.
Append new versions; never mutate previously verified content in place.
When upstream content changes, compute descendants and mark only affected artifacts invalidated.
Require independent verification before changing state to verified.
Compile a bounded context pack from direct dependencies.
Execute the contracted operation without authoring unrelated artifacts.
Record decisions, provenance, and audit events.
Emit the next eligible skill set and stop condition.

rules: The output directly and completely performs managing artifact lineage within its declared boundary.
Does the same canonical content produce the same hash?
Can every output reconstruct its input lineage?
Are unaffected branches preserved during invalidation?
Can a worker verify its own artifact?
Every material claim is traceable to an input, decision, executable check, or evidence item.
Required fields are complete and machine-readable.
The producing agent is not the approving reviewer.
Open uncertainty and residual risk are explicit; critical findings are never hidden by an aggregate score.
gate.passCondition: All mandatory rules pass, evidence targets the current artifact hash, and no unresolved critical finding applies.

handoff.stopWhen: Output contract is satisfied, a blocker is recorded, or a material human decision is required.

failureModes: producing prose without the contracted artifact
expanding scope without a decision record
description: Use when managing artifact lineage is required during kernel work, especially when the result must be traceable, independently reviewable, and safe to hand to another agent.
